description: The record encoding of SEALED.md section 2.3: each type, value to bytes, and records a reader must refuse. The fields-to-bytes vectors of each record are in that record's own file.

refusals.why: bytes left over after the last field
a choice (platform) outside its listed values
a choice (format) outside its listed values
a list that stands for a set is not sorted by its key
a list that stands for a set holds a key twice
a text that is not valid UTF-8

types.note: milliseconds since the Unix epoch, as a u64
the value is given in hex
